name: g2-neck-flip
description: Smoke run of the G2 neck access-plate flip gate (?g2=1, choreography only via enemies=0): hold right + hold fire, with closed-loop jumps fired from position windows ahead of each authored gap instead of a timed cadence — the open-loop version forked on the documented input-arrival alignment jitter (T-002), landing one run in the 120-122 gap. `pinned` doubles as the pocket-escape reflex: falling into the 126-129 underside pocket jams at its 129 wall, and one reactive jump rejoins at the chimney base. Proves the P2 lattice is crossable, the ritual fires at halt 140 / pivot 154, and the run finishes inside the neck interior.
